issues.title: Ingest Sebastian County’s 2026 budget
issues.detail: The county’s 2026 budget as filed with the state (artransparency.gov, May 2026), turned into a money trail with a page cite on every amount.

stamped.revealed: $65,424,970 across 32 funds. The largest: General Fund ($38,126,129), Road Fund ($10,395,504), Assessor's Commission Fund ($3,096,931). Every total marked complete adds to its parts to the cent; where the county’s own pages disagree, the page keeps the printed number and an open question below.
